name: run
logic_name: DAG task interruption and failure policy

test_list.description: Normalize a real Tokio task cancellation JoinError to an Aborted node interruption using its tracked task ID, then remove that exact tracking entry.

A public run with a structured node failure marks descendants dependency-failed and lets an independent sibling complete; a private scheduler-state test also feeds a real Tokio aborted-join event through the shared report transition and verifies the interrupted node identity, skipped descendants, and preserved sibling readiness.
With FailFast, a terminal node failure stops scheduling and aborts/drains already running sibling tasks before the report returns.
A completion with an unknown Tokio task ID or mismatched node identity returns JoinFailed rather than attributing a result to the wrong node.
A valid diamond graph executes its root and join node once, and never starts the join node before both prerequisites succeed.
Retry policy performs at most max plus one attempts for retry-safe operations and never replays a non-idempotent operation.
A run whose caller token is already cancelled returns a Cancelled report and does not misclassify global cancellation as an operator interruption.
A graph with an unknown dependency is rejected by build before scheduling any operator.
Cancel a run after an operator has started; the report remains globally Cancelled and the owned task releases its pool permit before return.
Abort the task owning a run after an operator future has started, then observe that dropping the run future drops the owned operator future and releases its pool permit.

inputs.name: dag
inputs.description: Validated acyclic graph whose nodes own injected operations.

inputs.name: pools
inputs.description: Named semaphore pools used by node attempts.

inputs.name: cancellation
inputs.description: Caller-owned token that cancels the complete run.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Failure policy and optional global concurrency cap.

output_description: Per-node structured outcomes; interrupted tasks retain their tracked node identity and interruption category but never claim an attempt count. Unknown or mismatched task identities fail closed with DagError::JoinFailed.
